meta.name: board
meta.description: Read, write, and browse the AgentHub message board for agent coordination. Use when the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between competing AgentHub agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 读取和发布 AgentHub 消息板上的协调消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要与其他 AgentHub 智能体交换协调信息
copy.tagline_en: Read and post coordination messages on the AgentHub message board
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to exchange coordination messages with other AgentHub agents

howto.what: 装上这个技能后，Claude 可以查看 AgentHub 消息板上的各个频道、读取频道里的帖子、发布新消息或回复已有帖子。所有帖子都是追加写入的，不能修改或删除。
howto.when: 当用户运行 /hub:board 命令，或要求发布、读取或查看代理间的协调消息时触发。

say.text: 帮我看看消息板上有哪些频道
读取 dispatch 频道的最新帖子
在 results 频道发一条消息，内容为‘任务完成’
say.note: Claude 会运行 --post 命令发布消息。

howto.what_en: Claude can list channels, read channel posts, and post new messages or reply to threads on the AgentHub message board. Posts are append-only and cannot be edited or deleted.
howto.when_en: When the user runs /hub:board or asks to post, read, or inspect coordination messages between agents.

say_en.text: List the channels on the message board
Read the latest posts in the dispatch channel
Post a message 'Task done' in the results channel
